01 — For Families

Kids Entertainment

Children's celebrations, elevated. Our professional children's entertainers bring energy, warmth and organisation to every party — so children are captivated from start to finish, and parents can actually enjoy the day too.

02 — For the Dancefloor

Premium DJs

The right DJ changes everything. Ours arrive with professional sound and lighting, an instinct for the room and the experience to move seamlessly from background elegance to a full, euphoric dancefloor.

  • Premium sound & lighting included
  • Music tailored to your crowd and your brief

Why P1 Playhouse Live

An Agency Built on the Occasion

Versatile enough for a child's birthday at noon and a black-tie gala by night — with the same standard of care at both.

One Agency, Every Occasion

Children's parties, DJs, live shows and private events under one roof — no juggling suppliers, no gaps between acts, one seamless experience.

Professional, Start to Finish

Clear communication, careful planning and performers who arrive prepared. You brief us once; we handle the entertainment from there.

Made Around You

Every event starts with your occasion, your guests and your vision. The entertainment is then shaped to fit — never the other way round.

P1 Playhouse Live is an entertainment agency for people who believe the entertainment is the event. From unforgettable children's celebrations to spectacular live performances, we bring every occasion to life — with polish, personality and a little gold dust.
